mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 255.5, it signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 255.5 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO has risen (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1220.0, it signals a weakening housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1220.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 93.0, it signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 93.0 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).
